Final for Publication

Type-l Zoning Map Amendment at
7811 South Ellis Avenue

From RS-3 to B3-5

The applicant and property owner, New Life Covenant Church-SE, is seeking
approval of a Type-1 Map Amendment from a RS-3 Residential Single-Unit
(Detached House) District to that of a B3-S Community Shopping District in
order to allow the proposed redevelopment of an existing three-story vacant,
former residential shelter building, located at 7811 South Ellis Avenue.

Subject property is 7,119.0 sq. ft. lot, improved with an 8,718.0 sq. ft. three-story
with basement brick and masonry vacant, former shelter building. The applicant is
proposing a change of use with the proposed redevelopment of the former shelter
into an office use building.

In order to facilitate the redevelopment of the existing building Applicant is
seeking a 2” reduction in the required front setback. There are no exterior

additions proposed.
